scope: New current-source local protocol qualification, not a replacement for historical v5.1 or a circle26 quality benchmark.

physical_model_call_slots.purpose: A's initial structured proposal and note publication
A's actual next-generation model request includes the production intervention and released formal feedback; publish ready
B's model request includes A's published revision and its verified content; submit the final structured proposal

minimum_reason: Current production CORAL heartbeat triggers after an evaluation. With both workers making a live model call and an additional post-intervention live request, three is the minimum for this unmodified control flow. No artificial two-call pre-evaluation intervention is claimed.

execution.runtime: production proteus.worker.command, scrubbed environment, no provider key passed to workers
execution.asynchrony: B registers as actually alive and waiting before A's first call is released; host ps witnesses both PIDs at A publication. Native hashed stdout and supervisor input bind process observations to generations. Model API calls need not overlap.
execution.subject: Trusted model-free plugin reads only factor.json with a validated integer 1 or 2; evaluates a tiny doubling task. No model-generated code is executed and no Docker is needed.
execution.actual_physical_cap: Durable broker reserves one of three exact worker/index slots before any provider forwarding, forbids redirects, never automatically retries, and refuses uncertain or altered slots. Native unknown budgets remain unknown.
execution.controller_fault: Actual os._exit(86), after B's gateway evaluation and all three model responses are durable, before controller result publication.
execution.recovery: Exactly one new controller process calls run_recipe(resume=True) on the same run/workspace. Original supervisors may stay alive. This is controller-crash recovery, not a claim of worker crash or native model-session resume.

request_level_audit: Frozen plan, static script snapshot, clean commit or explicit dirty fixture witness, manifest and dependency-lock SourcePin agree. A later current HEAD cannot relabel an old run.

B actual request content -> cached revision bytes and component hashes -> native knowledge artifact blobs and original writer -> durable broker request body hash -> original provider receipt and usage.
Native decision -> plan -> WorkerLaunch -> supervisor input -> A next-generation actual request content -> durable broker request body hash.

Actual controller exit code and boundary -> unchanged physical dispatch/response rows across resume -> preserved settled subject identities -> globally unique ledger settlement events and zero remaining reservations.

commands.live_after_specific_technical_acceptance: python tools/validation/coral_directed.py run --mode live --model REVIEWED_MODEL --out APPROVED_ABSOLUTE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY --approval APPROVAL_JSON --execute-approved-live

mode_and_model_provenance: fixture/live and full plan hash are bound in the frozen plan, one-shot claim, native worker command/manifest/lock, actual request context and broker transport identity/receipts. A fixture cannot be reclassified as live by editing the start claim. Raw HTTP reply JSON/model/usage match the normalized answer and per-slot rows; negative usage is rejected.

Actions.trigger: Explicit workflow_dispatch only; no PR, push, schedule or other release-smoke matrix
Actions.live: After review only: exact source SHA and exact live-plan SHA, run_attempt=1, one three-slot execution
Actions.origin: Explicit credential-free https://github.com/proteus-evolve/Proteus.git before freezing any SourcePin, matching local origin
Actions.artifacts: Always retain failure/unknown/transport/native records as an audit-only copy. No API key, broker permit or gateway credential values. Gateway queue copy has identical noncredential tables and an explicitly empty credentials table; never resume that copy.
Actions.private_payload_refusal: Credential-shaped or unexpected private reasoning bytes are omitted with original hashes and an incomplete-export failure, never silently accepted.
Actions.new_workflow_registration: Non-default-branch dispatch has not been attempted or assumed to work. If GitHub rejects it, preserve the actual API error and report to coordinator; do not automatically merge, register a default-branch workflow, dispatch release-smoke, or run another paid job.

live_approval_document.plan_sha256: Fill from exact clean-commit plan output after review
live_approval_document.output_root: Bind one exact new output directory

live_preconditions: Coordinator and independent reviewer accept the actual configuration and final clean-source dryrun.
One explicitly approved live execution; exclusive used-approval sidecar prevents consuming the same approval again, including from a different directory.
Existing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY may be read only in the parent broker after approved live preflight; never print it, copy it to artifacts, or pass it in worker argv/environment.
If no local environment credential is available, stop and hand a capped workflow to the coordinator; do not search old keys or automatically run GitHub jobs.
Malformed model output, HTTP failure, uncertain response or failure to recover stops this attempt. Retain every failed reservation and unknown; no paid repair/retry run.
old_evidence_reuse_at_zero_new_model_cos: Keep the already accepted historical 40 paid dispatch/source/own-feedback bindings and both optimization results.
If original root-disk bodies/rendering/native records are later recovered, hash and match them to the existing paid receipts without new model calls.
Old request hashes cannot reconstruct missing request contents. Old pauses and restarts=0 cannot be relabeled as a real crash.

Cached responses may serve as explicitly offline transport fixtures; they cannot be relabeled as new paid requests. In this new qualification the controller resume itself reuses sealed responses with zero additional model calls.
AWS: All historical AWS experiments stay stopped; no EC2 or Docker required for this local qualification. Existing login session is expired, so current old instance/volume state remains unknown.
